title: Ermes Gasparini predicts the Jerry Cadorette vs Artyom Morozov supermatch
description:
Ermes Gasparini comments on the supermatch between Jerry Cadorette and Artyom Morozov, that many consider Morozov’s victory a sure thing, perhaps based on how Jerry performed against him or against Levan.
However, Ermes suggests that direct comparisons can be misleading.
He acknowledges that Morozov’s hook is very powerful. 
Even so, Ermes believes that if Jerry manages to establish his position before Morozov, he can beat him. Ermes recalls the round where Genadi Kvikvinia tried to go in against Jerry, and Jerry pressed him back, implying that if Jerry sets his position, his press is also a serious threat to Morozov.
